Origin: Formed inside Boogie for unknown reasons
Overview (Player): A tiny model spelljamming ship that formed inside Boogie for reasons he cannot explain, half of it inexplicably missing. It is the same model as the personal miniature ship stolen from the instructor Saerthe — a connection Boogie has kept to himself.
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Boogie pulled a tiny model spelljamming ship from his own chest, the same kind he guided in training, except half of it is missing
• [S01] He has no explanation for how it formed inside him or why it is incomplete
• [S02] Boogie set it on the table for the crew; Tumak remarked that things had been going missing all over the academy
• [S02] Revealed to be the same model as the miniature spelljamming ship stolen from Saerthe

Overview (Player): A shirt Casey stole from Mirt's wardrobe and etched with the unfamiliar constellations he glimpsed inside it. It now sits hidden in Tumak's curtained bunk corner.
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Casey stole a shirt from Mirt's wardrobe and etched into it the constellation pattern he saw beyond
• [S01] Passed to Tumak's hidden bunk corner without explanation, and hidden without question

Overview (Player): A crimson bag of holding, along with valuables, that Tumak claimed for himself from inside Mirt's impossible wardrobe.
Key Details (Player): • [S01] Tumak found and claimed a crimson bag of holding and valuables within Mirt's wardrobe

Origin: Gifted to Mirt by the spellcaster Zerathis
Overview (Player): Mirt's wardrobe is an impossible object that opens not onto ordinary space but a bounded stretch of astral night, a magical replica of a place beyond Hakatha in the Viren star system, gifted to Mirt by the spellcaster Zerathis.
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] A wardrobe in Mirt's chambers whose interior opens onto a bounded stretch of astral night, a floor you can stand on and stars where walls should be
• [S01] Casey saw unfamiliar constellations and a flickering point inside, and a familiar voice told him 'Go there'
• [S01] Revealed by Mirt to be a magical replica of a place beyond Hakatha in the Viren star system, gifted by the spellcaster Zerathis

Origin: Delivered to Mirt in a crate from the sky dock
Overview (Player): A worm-like centipede creature, one of several that burst from the crate delivered to Mirt, kept alive and sealed back in the crate by Sol as potential evidence in the academy's spreading thefts.
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Worm-like centipede creatures burst from the crate delivered to Mirt and attacked the cadets
• [S01] Sol subdued the final creature alive and forced it back into the crate, sensing it might matter as evidence
• [S01] Mirt praised the instinct to keep it alive

Origin: Saerthe Abizjn's personal miniature, missing from the academy
Overview (Player): A personal miniature spelljamming ship belonging to the instructor Saerthe, taken from him in a manner not yet explained. It is the same model as the incomplete ship that formed inside Boogie.
Key Details (Player):
• [S02] Saerthe's own named miniature spelljamming ship, stolen from him in some manner not yet explained
• [S02] He briefly lost his composure over its theft during the cadets' helm exercise
• [S02] The same model as the half-missing ship that came out of Boogie's chest

Origin: Jammed into the wall of the simulation chamber during the salvage exercise
Overview (Player): A sigil-engraved metal rod Gregory pulled from the wall of the wrecked simulation chamber — a device built to feed on ambient magic and detonate, now spent. It bears the marking 'Vocath,' and Saerthe has taken it to study.
Key Details (Player):
• [S03] Gregory pried it from the wall of the wrecked simulation chamber, a length of sigil-engraved metal that arced energy as it came loose
• [S03] Built to feed on ambient magical energy and hold the charge until it could no longer contain it — arcane dynamite
• [S03] Assessed as spent and unlikely to detonate again, save near another strong source of magic
• [S03] Bears the marking 'Vocath'; Saerthe took it and drew it back before Boogie could examine it
• [S03] Saerthe produced an illusion of it for Mirt at the bridge

Item: Marked Crate at the Sky Dock
Origin: Placed at the Sky Dock by an unknown party
Overview (Player): A crate the crew found at the Sky Dock, tucked behind others and marked with the same symbol as the Vocath rod. It is not hollow but holds nothing living, and no one came for it while the crew watched.
Key Details (Player):
• [S03] A crate Boogie found tucked behind others at the Sky Dock, marked with the same symbol as the Vocath rod
• [S03] Knocking on it revealed nothing living inside, but it was not hollow
• [S03] Its contents would route through Mr. Blip, with Toril and Hakatha as destinations; no one came for it while the crew watched

Origin: Manifested by Tumak, drawn through a small portal tied to home
Overview (Player): A spectral blade Tumak manifests through a small portal at his call. When he first drew it, his half-runes flared and he felt a tether running toward the home he seeks — the portal itself a piece of that somewhere.
Key Details (Player):
• [S04] Summoned by Tumak for the first time in the tyrant-ship shaft fight, a spectral blade drawn out of a small portal
• [S04] As it left him, his two half-runes flared, and he felt for the first time a tether toward home — the portal a piece of that somewhere
• [S04] Thrown wide, it curved true and struck the last wisp as the Rune Keeper said all things find their way home
